mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (room_id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, msg_type, attach_url, created_at, updated_at, is_read) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{attachUrl}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT sender_id as merchantId, MAX(content) as lastMsg, MAX(created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as unreadCount FROM chat_messages WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY sender_id ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT id, sender_id as senderId, receiver_id as receiverId, content, msg_type as msgType, attach_url as attachUrl, created_at as createdAt FROM chat_messages WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} or receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT sender_id, receiver_id FROM chat_messages WHERE sender_id = #{userId} or receiver_id = #{userId}
